stores.name: Halden & Rowe Jewelers
stores.blurb: A glass counter, a bell over the door, and a man who knows your ring size by looking.

stores.name: The Watch Room
stores.blurb: Every brand under one roof, and a waiting list for the ones people want.

stores.name: Maison Vellard
stores.blurb: Appointment only. They bring the pieces to you.

stores.name: Northlight Gallery
stores.blurb: White walls, small labels, and prices you have to ask for.

stores.name: Old Hollow Antiques & Curiosities
stores.blurb: Three floors of other people's things. The owner says everything has a story.

entries.name: Casiot G-Shok
entries.blurb: Survives anything. Including fashion.

entries.name: Casiot Gold Digital
entries.blurb: Gold-tone, a calculator's worth of buttons.

entries.name: Seyko Presago
entries.blurb: An automatic movement for the price of a dinner out.

entries.name: Orchard Watch Ultra
entries.blurb: Tells the time, your heart rate, and everyone your messages.

entries.name: Tagg Heuser Monako
entries.blurb: The square one from the racing film.

entries.name: Grand Seyko Snowflake
entries.blurb: A dial like fresh snow, and a second hand that glides.

entries.name: Omegon Speedmeister Moonwatch
entries.blurb: The one that went to the Moon.

entries.name: Rolux Datesure 41
entries.blurb: The one people mean when they say "a Rolux."

entries.name: Rolux Subaquatic
entries.blurb: A two-year waiting list. Worth more the day it's on your wrist.

entries.name: Rolux Daytonna
entries.blurb: Nobody walks in and buys one. Somehow you did.

entries.name: Jaegar-LeCoultray Reverso
entries.blurb: It flips over. Polo players needed that once.

entries.name: Audemar Pigot Royal Ash
entries.blurb: Eight screws on an octagon bezel. Recognized across a room.

entries.name: Patrek Phillon Nautilos
entries.blurb: Retail is a formality. Resale is the price.

entries.name: Richard Millon RM 35
entries.blurb: Weighs nothing. Costs a house.

entries.name: Patrek Phillon Grand Complication
entries.blurb: A perpetual calendar, a minute repeater, and a two-year build.

entries.name: 18k gold signet ring
entries.blurb: Engraved with your initials, if you want them.

entries.name: Diamond solitaire, 5 carats, excellent
entries.blurb: Heavy enough to notice when you shake hands.

entries.name: Tiffard & Co. Setting, 1 carat
entries.blurb: The little blue box does a lot of the work.

entries.name: Cartrier Juste un Clou ring
entries.blurb: A gold nail, bent into a ring.

entries.name: Diamond tennis necklace, 10 carats
entries.blurb: Ten carats, in a line, all the way around.

entries.name: Van Cleaf Alhambra necklace
entries.blurb: Four-leaf clovers in gold and onyx.

entries.name: Iced-out custom pendant
entries.blurb: Your name, in diamonds, the size of your palm.

entries.name: 18k gold Cuban link, 12mm
entries.blurb: Heavy. You feel it when you turn your head.

entries.name: Cartrier Amour bracelet
entries.blurb: Screws shut. Comes with its own little screwdriver.

entries.name: Ines Varga — Portrait of a Neighbor
Paul Severin — Still Life with Lemons
Jun Takeda — I Was Here (neon)
entries.blurb: It glows pink and hums slightly.

entries.name: Olga Meret — Tapestry for a Long Winter
Vic Dorrance — Soup Can Sunrise
entries.blurb: Bright, flat and instantly familiar. That's the point.

entries.name: Letter signed by a Revolutionary War general
Mission patch flown to the Moon
Dinner menu from an ocean liner, 1912
Tyrannosaur tooth
entries.blurb: Sixty-six million years old, and still sharp.

entries.name: Rubber chicken, signed by a famous comedian
entries.blurb: The signature is on the beak.

entries.name: Mounted jackalope
entries.blurb: The seller swore it was real. The seller winked.

entries.name: Garden gnome that toured the world
entries.blurb: Comes with an album of it at forty landmarks.

entries.name: Toast with a face in it, preserved
Plaster cast of a Bigfoot footprint
World's Okayest Boss trophy, solid bronze
Poseidon's Trident
entries.blurb: Always slightly damp. Nobody can explain it.

entries.name: Pandora's Box
entries.blurb: Still closed. Keep it that way.

entries.name: Diamond Pickaxe
entries.blurb: Mines through anything, apparently.

entries.name: The Philosopher's Stone
entries.blurb: It turns nothing into gold. You've tried.

entries.name: A sword pulled from a stone
entries.blurb: The stone came too. It's in the garage.

entries.name: Rolux Yacht-Voyager
entries.blurb: A sailing watch with a raised timing bezel. Equally at home on shore.

entries.name: Rolux Oyster Perpetual 36
entries.blurb: A steel bracelet, a clean dial, and no date window.

entries.name: Rolux Explorer 36
entries.blurb: The black dial with the big three, six, and nine.

entries.name: Seyko Alpinist
entries.blurb: A green dial and a compass bezel, for the long way home.

entries.name: Tissoe Gentleperson
entries.blurb: A clean steel everyday watch that fits under a shirt cuff.

entries.name: Hamiltone Ventura Auto
entries.blurb: The triangular case. Hard to mistake it for anything else.

entries.name: Grand Seyko White Birch
entries.blurb: A silver-white dial textured like a stand of birch trees.

entries.name: Tudar Pelagos
entries.blurb: A titanium diver with a bracelet that adjusts over a wetsuit.

entries.name: Longinez Legend Diver
entries.blurb: Two crowns and a rotating dive bezel tucked under the crystal.

entries.name: Orys Big Crown Pointer Date
entries.blurb: An extra hand points to the date around the edge of the dial.

entries.name: Omegon Aquaterra
entries.blurb: A steel watch that goes from the beach to the office.

entries.name: Cartrier Ballon Bleu
entries.blurb: A round case with a blue crown tucked into its side.

entries.name: Breitlong Superocean 42
entries.blurb: A steel diver with bold markers and a rotating timing bezel.

entries.name: Audemar Pigot Royal Ash Offshore
entries.blurb: The bigger sports chronograph, with an octagonal bezel and rubber strap.

entries.name: Patrek Phillon Aquanote
entries.blurb: A rounded octagonal steel case, a patterned dial, and a composite strap.

entries.name: Vacheran Constantine Patrimony
entries.blurb: A slim gold dress watch with a quiet dial and slender hands.

entries.name: A. Langer & Sohn Saxonia Thin
entries.blurb: A thin gold case, two hands, and nothing extra on the dial.

entries.name: Jakob & Co. Billionaire Timeless Treasure
entries.blurb: Yellow diamonds cover the case and bracelet. The price is a fortune by itself.
